text.tspan: GiCoffee on Gitea, station S4, CSCI 435 Showcase 2
Rule checks and AI review on every PR
Every check we had passed this PR
and our unit tests passed it. These two didn't:
Security rating on new code (needs A)
Reliability rating on new code (needs A)
New Go handler has no test
A data race in modules/timeutil. Gitar
marked it unrelated to this PR.
PRs, especially AI-written ones, arrive faster than
people can review them, and linters only catch
what they're set up to catch. Bugs, security holes
and untested code get merged on green checks.
Why not just ask an AI assistant?

SonarQube sets a measurable bar every PR must
meet. Gitar covers what needs judgment and
